mentions.name: Wood Shop Air Scrubber Auto-Controller
mentions.description: A DIY cascading small motor starter built with an Arduino, octocoupler relays, and an incoming air particulate sensor, designed to automatically control six small air scrubbers in a wood shop.
mentions.problem: The author is allergic to nearly everything in the wood shop air but loves the hobby; the particulate sensor needed for the build is delayed about 180 days in shipping from China.
mentions.audience: Personal use in the author's own wood shop
mentions.source_excerpt: i'm using AI to goad me into making a cascading small motor starter thing with an air particulate sensor that's taking 180 days to show up from China, to automatically control my 6 small air scrubbers in my wood shop since i'm allergic to just about everything in there but love the hobby
